reason: Owner directive 2026-11-03 (ADR0023) keeps agents open-ended under supervision; context management must not impose turn or runtime caps.

edits.before: - **Size phases and cap scope.** Limit files per phase, set turn budgets, account for mechanism costs.
edits.after: - **Keep the active context small.** Separate independent slices, pass raw inputs by reference and retain concise recovery state. Use the installed [watchdog](../watchdog/SKILL.md) for open-ended supervision instead of turn or time caps.
